artworks.title: A Grand Illusionistic Ceiling
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown washes over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund and an Anonymous Donor
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a highly detailed architectural design reminiscent of Baroque or Renaissance ceilings. It features ornate panels, ceremonial motifs, and sculptural embellishments. The drawing includes multiple roundels and medallions depicting allegoric figures and intricate floral designs. The central ceiling painting shows a sky with mythical figures, creating a sense of depth and grandeur typical of trompe-l'oeil painting. The drawing is in grayscale and may have been created as a preliminary study for a mural or fresco.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1771: The Temple of Asclepius
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Vasi after Giuseppe Palazzi (designer) and Paolo Posi (architect)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure. It showcases a large central building with a domed top and intricate columns, richly decorated with statues and ornamental details. Smaller architectural elements on each side mirror its opulence. The artwork includes sculptural elements and decorative arcades, set against a backdrop of stylized clouds in the sky. In the foreground, there are several people and a draped cloth on steps leading to the main building, adding depth and perspective to the scene. The style is reminiscent of Baroque architectural illustrations.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1773: The Temple of Peace
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Vasi after Giuseppe Palazzi (designer) and Paolo Posi (architect)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an elaborate architectural structure. The scene features a grand temple-like building with numerous statues and reliefs. The entrance has arches and columns leading to a central dome with smaller statues on top. There is a wide staircase with people at the base, along with groups of figures engaging in various activities in the foreground. Horse-drawn carriages are on the right, and flag-bearing pedestals with classical sculptures are on either side. The sky has textured clouds. Inscriptions in the foreground suggest the drawing's dedication and purpose, likely serving as a commemorative piece for an event.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1785: The Temple of Jupiter Begun by Tarquinius Priscus with the Marvel of Accius Naevius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a neoclassical temple facade. The drawing shows a symmetrical architectural structure with columns, a pediment, statues on columns and the building, relief sculptures, friezes, an inscription above the entrance, steps leading up to the temple, smaller statues, and people engaged in activities at the base of the stairs. The scene is set against a cloudy sky with detailed shading and line work.

artworks.title: The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1785: A Pleasure Palace with an Air Balloon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural facade with sculptures and decorations. The building is adorned with statues, columns, and stonework. Figures are positioned throughout the scene. In the center, there is a globe-like structure on a pedestal, surrounded by figures engaged in various activities. Peacocks and additional statues are included in the composition. The drawing is detailed and precise, emphasizing classical and decorative architecture.

artworks.title: Débit d'Albums avec Procédés nouveaux (New Methods for the Sale of Lithograph Albums)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals in a humorous scene. One person holds a book or album while being coerced to buy it by two others. The background features intricate foliage, and text above the trio reads "DÉBIT D'ALBUMS Avec Procédés nouveaux. 1827." Below, text implies the necessity of purchasing the album. The characters wear detailed period attire.

artworks.title: Le Diable emporte les Albums (The Devil Runs Off with the Lithograph Albums)
artworks.description: This is an illustration showing a scene with a devilish character. In the center, the devilish creature is taking albums from two figures at an art display booth. Above them, there are various ethereal figures, including an angelic being and other mythical creatures. The image includes decorative elements like foliage framing and textures around the figures. The title "Le Diable emporte les Albums" is inscribed below the drawing.

artworks.title: Vainqueurs et vaincus, tout est fricot pour le diable (The Vanquishers and the Vanquished, All Food for the Devil)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a puppet show with various characters. The scene captures a lively puppet theatre where puppets with exaggerated features are in action. One puppet with a pointed hat and a stick appears to be engaging with a devil-like figure with horns. Below them, on the left side, another puppet seems to be struggling or caught up in the drama. To the right, a bearded puppet reminiscent of a wise old man oversees the action. The image has a vintage feel with intricate textures and shading, showcasing a style similar to 19th-century satirical art. The caption below reads, "Vainqueurs et vaincus tout est ficot pour le diable," suggesting a theme of mischief and folly.

artworks.title: Lanciers en Marche (Lancers on the March)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cavalry procession. Mounted soldiers are depicted moving through a wooded area. The drawing shows soldiers carrying lances, riding horses among detailed trees. The soldiers appear to be in a military scene with some horses in motion. The ink used enhances the textures of the horses, soldiers, and foliage, creating a dynamic scene of a military procession.

artworks.title: Paysans se reposant dans la Campagne (Peasants Resting in the Countryside)
artworks.description: The landscape features undulating hills with a prominent peak in the distance on the left. The painting shows mist or haze in the central area, softening the terrain. Brushstrokes create texture, visible in the foliage and terrain. On the right, figures gather under a tree. The image has a monochromatic palette, emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: River Landscape with a Passing Storm
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with touches of roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a flowing river seen from a low vantage point. Rugged cliffs with a waterfall are in the background. A structure is visible on the cliffs. The artwork has fine brushstrokes detailing trees, the waterfall, and the river. The color palette is monochromatic. The river flows swiftly, rocks are visible, and trees line a path on the right. Two cows are present. The landscape transitions into rocky outcroppings and dense trees in the distance.

artworks.title: The Public Scribe
artworks.medium: etching with touches of roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with animals and people around a small establishment. The central focus is a public scribe's booth with an individual inside. To the right, a person is sitting in a chair with a dog playing with a child. On the left, another figure is near a wooden wall. A dog is lying on the ground in front of the establishment. The setting has wooden elements and a textured wall. The drawing is detailed with linework and light and shadow.

artworks.title: Passage du Mont St. Bernard (Napoleon's Army Crossing the St. Bernard Pass)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a military group traveling through a mountainous pass. The image features soldiers on foot and on horseback moving through a snowy mountain landscape. The background shows snow-covered peaks framing the scene. In the foreground and midground, there are soldiers in uniforms carrying rifles and wearing various hats. The scene captures a sense of movement as the soldiers traverse the terrain. One individual appears to be giving directions, standing out with more elaborate attire, possibly indicating a leadership role. Structures at the base of the mountains provide scale and context to the scene. The drawing suggests a historical military event.

artworks.title: Le Giaour (The Infidel)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure on horseback, raising an arm against a rocky landscape. The image depicts a dynamic scene where a figure rides a rearing horse. The posture of the horse and the raised arm of the figure suggest motion or action. The background reveals a rugged, rocky terrain, with structures that hint at a distant city skyline. The sweeping lines and shading give the drawing a dramatic, intense atmosphere.

artworks.title: Apollo and Nymphs in a Landscape with a Bust of Pan
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures in a pastoral setting. One figure lies in the foreground, nude, on drapery or soft natural ground cover. In the midground to the right, a standing figure carries an amphora and gestures to the side. Behind, another person holds a child. To the left, an additional duo seems engaged or turning towards the central setting. The background is detailed with foliage and trees, creating a serene and naturalistic environment. The use of line work and shading provides depth and texture to the scene. The style reflects influences from classicism.

artworks.title: Allegorical Portrait of Jean-Baptiste Hüet
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I after Jean-Augustin Léveillé
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Neil and Ivan Phillips in memory of Jacqueline Getty Phillips
artworks.description: The image is a classical-style portrait in a reddish tone. It depicts a person's profile with long hair tied back. The portrait is set inside a circular frame with the inscription "HUET NE LE 22 OCTOBRE" and is surrounded by decorative motifs of laurel leaves and roses. Three cherubic figures with curly hair and small wings are engaging in artistic activities; one holds a quill, another supports a blank sheet, and the third gazes at the work. The cherubs are depicted in a playful manner, with one clutching a flower and another holding a brush or pen. Below the frame, there are objects including a scroll, an artist’s palette, and botanical elements. The background of the image is a plain, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Portrait of the Artist's Father
artworks.medium: watercolor with touches of varnish on light brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with only his upper body visible. He is positioned at a three-quarter angle, slightly turned to his left, but facing the viewer with a subtle expression. The man's facial features include a light complexion, full cheeks, and prominent eyes, while his hair is dark, curly, and falls around his face and ears. He wears a high-collared white shirt with ruffles peeking through the opening of a dark, formal coat. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background of the image is plain and uniformly dark, set within an oval vignette.

artworks.title: Les amateurs de tableaux (The Picture Enthusiasts)
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper

artworks.title: Title Page for "Plusieurs Testes Coiffées a la Persienne"
artworks.description: The image depicts a young person from the waist up, facing slightly to the right with one arm resting on a surface. They have soft facial features and curly hair, partially covered by a voluminous beret-style hat. The subject wears a robe-like garment with puffy sleeves, a bow at the neck, and multiple folds of fabric. They hold a piece of paper or scroll with visible text. The background is lightly sketched with decorative elements like round fruits and leaves. The etching is monochrome with intricate linework conveying texture and depth.

artworks.title: Woman in a Feathered Turban, Turned to the Right
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile facing to the right. They are depicted from the shoulders up, with their body turned to display their left side. The person has distinct facial features such as a prominent nose, full lips, and expressive eyes looking upwards. Their hair is styled in curls with a headdress embellished with feathers and a tassel. The individual is wearing a draped garment secured with a brooch, along with earrings. The background is plain with a light texture and enclosed in an oval border.

artworks.title: Young Moor in a Feathered Turban, Turned to the Left
artworks.description: The image depicts a person's upper body in profile, facing left. They have distinct facial features with a notable nose, brow, and closed lips. The individual wears a turban with a feather on the right side, partially covering their dark hair. They are dressed in a high-collared garment with detailed lines and button-like embellishments down the front. The background is plain with a slight outline or oval shape, containing no additional elements or context.

artworks.title: Woman in a Feathered Turban with a Veil, Turned to the Right
artworks.dimensions:
plate (oval): 9.5 x 7 cm (3 3/4 x 2 3/4 in.)
sheet: 10.6 x 8.2 cm (4 3/16 x 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This image shows a person with their body turned slightly to the side, and their head looking over their shoulder towards the viewer. The person's facial features are delicately rendered, with a composed expression and eyes that appear to be looking directly at the viewer. They have elaborate, voluminous hair styled upwards with decorative elements resembling feathers or embellishments, and a long drape trailing from the hairstyle. The person's clothing appears to be intricately detailed with lines suggesting texture and layers. The image is in black and white, resembling an etching or engraving, set against a textured, nondescript background. On the left side of the image is the word "Bella." Earring adornments are seen dangling from the ear.

artworks.title: Young Moor with a Slight Beard and Feathered Turban, Turned to the Left
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. The man is positioned with his head turned slightly to the right, gazing away from the viewer. His facial features include a prominent nose, defined cheekbones, and a slightly furrowed brow, with curly hair that is partially hidden by an elaborate turban. The turban is adorned with a decorative band and a large feather emerging from the center. The man's attire consists of a richly textured jacket featuring a high collar and intricate button detailing on the chest. There are no visible signs of jewelry. The background is simple and unadorned, with minimal detail. The image has an oval vignette around the portrait.

artworks.title: Sultaness Adorned with Pearls, Turned to the Left
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the shoulders up, facing slightly to the left. They have curly hair, a turban-like headpiece, and are wearing a simple garment with a necklace. The background is a textured oval frame with no specific details or scenery.
